title: MC Oldenbyte Community
description:
This is the modpack used for the Hardcore Oldenbyte Community Server. It contains all the needed clientside mods for the server.

Can also be used to get a similar experience on your own server or in single-player.
body:
# Modpack for Oldenbyte Hardcore Community-Server

The Oldenbyte-Modpack is a carefully curated **Vanilla+ visual and immersion** modpack for Minecraft 1.21.10, designed to make the game look, feel, and sound dramatically better—without changing core gameplay or progression.

This pack focuses on **atmosphere, exploration, and performance**, delivering a cinematic experience while staying true to the soul of vanilla Minecraft.

## Key Features

- Vanilla-friendly gameplay
- Fabric-based & lightweight
- Highly configurable
- Client & server compatible
- Perfect for survival, exploration, and building


## Immersion & Atmosphere
Every biome feels distinct, alive, and believable.
- Step into a living world enhanced with:
- Dynamic seasons and biome-based ambience
- Rich environmental and ambient sounds
- Advanced sound physics for caves, structures, and open spaces
- Reactive music that adapts to your surroundings
- Subtle visual effects, particles, camera motion, and weather enhancements


## Exploration Enhanced
Exploring feels fresh again, without becoming overwhelming.
Oldenbyte dramatically improves world exploration with:
- Fully overhauled **dungeons, temples, strongholds, monuments, ancient cities, and mansions**
- Improved structure variety while keeping vanilla balance
- More rewarding and atmospheric exploration without adding complex mechanics


## Visual Overhaul (Optional & Modular)
You can mix, match, or disable visuals freely.
The pack includes a wide selection of shaders and resource packs, allowing you to tailor visuals to your system:
- High-quality and performance-friendly shader options (BSL, Complementary, Solas, VanillaPlus, MakeUp UltraFast, and more)
- Enhanced animations, models, textures, and GUI
- Dynamic lighting, better foliage, connected textures, and expressive mobs


## Performance First
Beauty without sacrificing performance.
Despite its visuals, Oldenbyte is optimized for smooth gameplay:
- Sodium, Lithium, Iris, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, C2ME, and more
- Dynamic FPS scaling and memory optimizations
- Designed to run well on **mid-range** systems


**Oldenbyte** is ideal for players who want Minecraft to feel **deeper, more atmospheric, and visually stunning** without turning it into a different game.
